method: Fresh independent primary downloads. Geographic assignment checked using matplotlib C polygon inclusion including holes; annual totals independently decoded from JSON-stat indices without project parsers.
limits: The underlying series uses annual reference years with a separate month dimension; all twelve months are summed exactly once.
NUTS2024 simplified boundaries and a2026 data vintage are retrospective; historical boundary/vintage consistency is not independently reconstructed.
Region of airport coordinates is not measured airport catchment; regional accommodation nights include residents and arrivals by all transport modes.
Accommodation nights are not passengers or visits. This annual proxy cannot validate passenger seasonality.
Point-on-boundary behaviour is implementation dependent; no observed assignment mismatch occurred in this sample.
